label: Role (Sync Gateway)
type: an admin-created, uncataloged bundle of channel grants - a THIRD structurally distinct thing called 'role' in this ontology
note: Do not conflate with capella-role:* (Capella's fixed catalog of management-plane roles: Organization Owner, Project Owner, Project Data Writer) or rbac-role:role (the coarse placeholder for Capella/server data-plane RBAC roles manipulated by GRANT/REVOKE). All three are called 'role' in their respective docs; all three are structurally different: sgw:role is an ad hoc, customer-named, channel-grant bundle with no fixed catalog at all, unlike the other two. This same-word-different-thing pattern is exactly what cross-product-family testing was designed to catch - see reconciliation.md.
